items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Miles went to hang out with Sly Stone... They got to hanging out. They got to talking.

ctx.x: Jimmy was at the – what was it? – the jazz festival in Newport? with Miles when he changed his – with the drummer. He heard Sly Stone.

Oh yeah. I think Miles went to hang out with Sly Stone, who was working in the Gardens in New York, downtown. He – they got to hanging out. They got to talking. Sly was telling him, he say, “Yeah, man, I worked in the Gardens – Madison Square Garden last night. I made 83 grand.” Miles say, “83 grand!” Right after that I went by Miles’s house. He had a closet full of funny-looking little suits and shoes and hats and all that stuff. I say, oh, wait a minute. So he went into the music. He had the wah-wah pedals.…
